target.statement: MAPS with COMET-QE selection achieves a COMET score of 87.6 on English→Chinese translation using text-davinci-003, compared to 86.2 for the Baseline.

compute.basis: The target requires calling the closed-source text-davinci-003 API for knowledge mining, candidate generation, and QE scoring, which is not freely available and may be deprecated; the code is released but depends on external APIs and models, making reproduction infeasible without API access.

blockers: Requires access to the closed-source text-davinci-003 API, which is not freely available and may be deprecated.
The released code depends on external APIs and models (e.g., COMET-QE) that may require additional setup or access.
title: Exploring Human-Like Translation Strategy with Large Language Models
